derivation: apparently from H4448 (מָלַל); I have talked (i.e. loquacious)

occurrences.text: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti–ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
